items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: He came by to see me where I was playing

ctx.x: He is well known in California, in fact, all over. Incidentally, he just passed here recently, I found out from Billy Daniels who was here in Denver at the Warehouse, a few weeks ago. He came by to see me where I was playing at the (unintelligible), and Billy Daniels told me that Arthur Lee Simpkins had passed. And the last time I saw Arthur Lee when he was alive was in Los Angeles. He had a string of apartment buildings about a block long. (Inaudible). And he always toured Europe. And the guy was -- he was…
